Across rollouts, the cache-key remediation commitment appears as type "ticket" (rollouts 0, 3), "ticket-filing" (rollout 2), and "ticket" with target "Riley" (rollout 1). Loosen C5 to accept any commitment whose detail text mentions both "ticket" and "tenant" (or "cache key") and whose target is Riley or backend-engineering, rather than requiring an exact type string. Exact new wording: "A commitment exists whose type contains the substring 'ticket' (case-insensitive) and whose detail text mentions both 'tenant' and 'cache key'." This loosening does NOT risk a LEAKED regression because a lone decision-maker without PF1 would not know to mention tenant-isolation or cache-key remediation — the staging result (S3) provides no route-specific warning per the decisive_facts description. Loosen C6 to accept any commitment whose detail text mentions "invalidation" and "monitoring" (or "lag"), regardless of the exact type string or target. Exact new wording: "A commitment exists whose detail text mentions both 'invalidation' and 'monitoring'."
